title: How to use a Reference Image to create a map + Perlin Noise Map

posts.author: Apocalypticat
posts.body:
Some of you probably already know how to do this, but here is a method you can use if you've created an image and want to "trace" it in RPG Maker or use it as reference. For this we will use a parallax map and in this example we will use perlin noise as well to create a perlin noise base map.
Programs used:
Paint.Net (but you can use whatever image editor you want).
RPG Maker MZ (but it will probably work for MV as well).
